extraction_time_estimate.full_train_visual_or_motion: multi-day GPU job; should wait for pilot signal
extraction_time_estimate.motion_model_pilot_gpu: 4-12 GPU hours; higher if decoding is slow

gpu_cpu_cost.multiscale_event: GPU for raw extraction, CPU ok for pooling/indexing
gpu_cpu_cost.text: 1 GPU optional; CPU possible but slower
gpu_cpu_cost.visual: GPU recommended; CPU not practical for video/frame models

pilot_scope.purpose: feasibility and signal audit only; no full extraction

span_ranking_sample_feasibility: yes: reuse C12 M1000 generated pools and C12-5V failure IDs for pilot-only scoring

storage_estimate.event_tokens_fp16_full_train: smaller than dense frame tokens if pooled to 8-32 events/video
storage_estimate.subtitle_sentence_embeddings_fp16_order: depends on subtitle sentence segmentation; expected low single-digit GiB for TVR train
storage_estimate.visual_clip_tokens_fp16_full_train: tens of GiB if dense frame/clip tokens are kept; small pilot <2 GiB

timestamp_alignment_feasibility.existing_tv_feature_stride: current TVR features use 1.5s style clip alignment
timestamp_alignment_feasibility.new_feature_alignment: feasible if extraction records frame timestamp, clip center, and video duration normalization
timestamp_alignment_feasibility.risk: medium: subtitle sentence boundaries and video frame sampling must be canonicalized

vr_recall_sample_feasibility: yes: use train_fit/calib_select/calib_holdout only, with C7-B6/CONQUER as teacher or hard-negative source
